title: Spatial Layout — Edison Science Upstream Contract
description: Defines the spatial node graph for a ship platform. Each zone represents a compartment with a volumetric envelope, deck assignment, and dashboard display coordinates. Zones are connected by airflow paths defined in a companion air_flow_paths.json file. This schema also documents the room-touch frequency coefficients (traffic density) used by the transmission core to scale contact rates.

description.description: Human-readable description of the spatial layout.

deck_dimensions.description: Optional overall vessel dimensions for dashboard rendering.

zones.description: Array of compartment/room node definitions. Each zone is a node in the spatial graph.

id.description: Unique zone identifier. Used as the primary key for all cross-references in air_flow_paths.json, protocols.json, and simulation_history.json. Convention: PascalCase or Snake_Case, no spaces (e.g., 'Bridge', 'Mess_Hall', 'Engine_Room').

type.description: Compartment functional type. Determines default agent routing in the FRED schedule and symptom-reporting behavior. 'Free' = common area, 'Dining' = food service, 'Room' = quarters/berthing, 'Medical' = sick bay, 'Engineering' = machinery spaces.

traffic.description: Room-touch frequency coefficient. Controls how often agents visit this zone during their FRED schedule and scales the avgR contact pool size. 'high' = frequently visited (galley, mess hall), 'medium' = moderate (corridors, bridge), 'low' = restricted access (engineering, medical).

volume_m3.description: Room volume in cubic meters. MUST be positive. Used by the py-contam bridge for concentration calculations (C = M / V) and by the air sniffer for sampled volume computation.

deck.description: Vertical deck assignment. Used for HVAC zone grouping (rooms on the same deck typically share an HVAC recirculation loop) and for spatial deck map rendering in the dashboard.

display.description: Dashboard display coordinates for the Plotly spatial deck map. The GIS spatial bridge tool computes these automatically from polygon centroids.

x.description: Horizontal display coordinate (arbitrary units, typically meters from bow).

y.description: Vertical display coordinate (arbitrary units, typically meters from centerline).

base_ach.description: Optional override for base air changes per hour. If not specified, the HVAC zone ACH from air_flow_paths.json is used.

examples.description: Gleaves-class destroyer baseline layout — 6 compartments across 3 decks.

zones.description: Sick bay and medical treatment facility
